$comment: Copy this to profiles/<repo>.json and edit. Your copy is gitignored -- profiles name real
repositories and environments, so they stay on your machine.
The leading underscore keeps this example out of profile matching.
delegate_reason must say why *this* command is yours to run rather than the agent's. It is shown
to you verbatim, so an unexplained request reads as arbitrary and gets ignored. Real reasons:
the repository's own docs forbid the agent running it, it needs credentials the session should
not spend, or it needs more memory than the session has.

checks.delegate_reason: Needs more memory than the session has. Ask the user to run it and wait for their output.

checks.when: the change touches a repository, a schema, or a migration
